name: Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm) via Octave Summation
definition: Generates a multi-scale noise field by summing multiple octaves of base simplex noise, each scaled by a power of two in frequency.
summary: Fractal Brownian Motion via Octave Summation generates multi-scale procedural volume data by summing scaled noise octaves, differing from Simplex Noise by introducing hierarchical detail in 3D space.
